base_observations: Across all four before/after still pairs, shortening reduces long connected foreground crossings while retaining a recognizable base and perceptible two-direction short cross marks.
At az30 and120 the dark foreground lattice has visibly fewer long connections. At az210 the left edge remains locally clustered; at az300 some patches remain uneven and light.

The shortened top marks often read as scattered small X texture instead of continuous tonal hatching. This is a remaining style limitation, but not an empty or unreadable base in the reviewed outputs.
Native images and enlarged nearest-neighbor crops both show residual overlaps near the visible base edge; shortening has not produced uniform spacing.
whole_object_observations: Complete shade, stem and base are visible and recognizable in every displayed frozen trajectory panel; no obvious full-part disappearance or image clipping observed.
Shade retains grouped nearly parallel lines, close duplicates and irregular gaps, particularly apparent around az120 and210; this remains the broadest visible whole-object quality blocker.

Stem remains legible but stroke lengths/spacing and dark vertical aggregation are uneven. Some neighboring base ink is visible in rectangular stem crops and must not be confused with stem-label leakage.
Preserved outlines and rings make the three-part lamp readable; their presence alone does not establish complete surface hatch coverage or correct hiding.

trajectory_observations.orbit: Viewed all24 panels plus native-size first/middle/last sheet. Base remains visible around full orbit; visible hatch and lightness change across angle. Contacts cannot establish per-stroke temporal alignment, flicker or absence of hidden-line leakage.
trajectory_observations.zoom: Viewed all16 panels plus first/middle/last sheet. Whole lamp remains framed from near to far and back; short base crosses remain visible, becoming finer at far distances. No LOD or width calibration conclusion.
trajectory_observations.edit: Viewed all24 panels and first/middle/last sheet. Before12 and after12 states show localized visible base simplification; apparent non-target similarity is qualitative here and numeric isolation belongs to separate validator.

media_validation_read_only_receipt.attribution: Read saved producer receipt:64 frames decoded RGB-exact. Reviewer did not independently re-decode; decode proves media integrity, not temporal stability.

preserved_failures: Inherited whole-object visualNO_GO, hidden-profile/rim-depth failures, prior unit004/005 diagnostic-only findings, and limited temporal coverage remain.

Root reported outer batch returned143 after layers/orbit/zoom childrenrc0 and before mediaSTART; original receipt preserved and standalone media resumedrc0 with unchanged science. Reviewer did not independently reproduce that interruption.
p1_distance_reduced: The real complete434-path GT asset now demonstrates a useful isolated base length edit and supplies all three presentation trajectories with less foreground crossing clutter. This reduces the length-control and selected-asset demonstration gaps; the shade spacing, whole-object visual quality, independent temporal coverage and reconstructed-input gaps remain.
recommended_next_step: One shade-only spacing/distribution intervention under a frozen DEV candidate and independent visible-shade support gates; keep chosen .12 base recipe,24stem paths, widths, inks, renderer and non-target identities fixed. Focus on close parallel stacking rather than another base length/density retry.
limitations: All evidence uses previously exposed authored GT lamp, GT labels and manual directions.
Static all-frame contact inspection is not video playback or an independent temporal audit.
VisualGO is bounded aesthetic/legibility judgement and cannot override a frozen quantitative failure.
